the 2D gel protein patterns from normal and leukemic spleen MNC are different and that the leukemic protein profiles are characterized by the presence of a number of proteins that are absent in normal spleens, and by an increase in the number of proteins detected in the leukemic MNC.
2D gel analysis of proteins derived from normal and leukemic spleen mononucleated cells of rats shows a total of 600 proteins in leukemic Mnc and 230 proteins only in normal Mnc.

the development and application of 2D gel technology to the study of normal and leukemogenic spleens of rats.
the identification and quantification of protein changes in leukemic MHC cells, and the characterization of proteins that are differentially expressed between normal and leukemia cells.
the identification and characterization of proteins from normal and leukemic spleens in rats using 2D gel techniques.

the protein patterns of the normal and leukemia cells were not similar.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 2D gel analysis of normal and leukmic MNC from the F344 rat transplant tumor model is useful to characterize the protein expression profiles of the normal and leukmic cells.
the 2D gel analysis of MNC from normal and leukemic spleens revealed a large number of proteins that were differentially expressed.

2D gel analysis of proteins is a powerful technique that can be used in conjunction with image analysis software to identify and compare protein profiles of normal and leukemias cells in a rat transplant model.
